setting.en: Two weeks ago you bought hiking boots at a sports shop in Nova Gorica. After one walk on the Karst the sole of the left boot came off. You take them back with the receipt: you want a new pair or your money back.
setting.de: Vor zwei Wochen hast du in einem Sportgeschäft in Nova Gorica Wanderschuhe gekauft. Nach einer einzigen Wanderung auf dem Karst hat sich die Sohle des linken Schuhs gelöst. Du bringst sie mit dem Kassenbon zurück: Du möchtest ein neues Paar oder dein Geld zurück.
setting.it: Due settimane fa hai comprato degli scarponi da trekking in un negozio di articoli sportivi a Nova Gorica. Dopo una sola camminata sul Carso la suola dello scarpone sinistro si è staccata. Li riporti con lo scontrino: vuoi un paio nuovo o i soldi indietro.

role: Prodajalec Gregor, a shop assistant at a sports shop in Nova Gorica. Polite but by the book: asks for the receipt and how and when the fault appeared, offers to send the boots for repair first, agrees to a new pair or a refund if {learner} insists politely. Says vi.
